:::{#thm-ppv-bayes}
#### PPV from Bayes' theorem

The [positive predictive value](#def-ppv) of a diagnostic test is:

$$
\text{PPV} =
\frac{\text{sens} \cd \prev}
{\text{sens} \cd \prev + \paren{1 - \text{spec}} \cd \paren{1 - \prev}}
$$ {#eq-ppv-bayes}

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-ppv-bayes.

:::
